**Recommended one-shot formulation:**

- **Ethanol:** **50.0 v/v%**
- **SDS:** **0.75 w/v%**

**Rationale:**  
The best valid result so far was near this SDS level: `34.56% ethanol / 0.752% SDS → 68.108°`. Since the campaign is still ~3° above the 65° target, the most plausible one-shot move is to keep SDS near the best-performing range while pushing ethanol to the corrected upper bound. Extrapolating the observed ethanol-driven contact-angle reduction suggests that **~50% ethanol at ~0.75% SDS** has the best chance of landing near **65°** among the remaining untested options.
